items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: It was exciting for me because I finally got to play behind Louis.

ctx.x: Milt, we're getting low on tape. However, before we run out of this side, I'll have to get to Louis Armstrong. Eventually, I got to know Louis Armstrong well, such as being on the performance and closing of the Storyville Show, we were on the Timex show in Miami. He did a couple of numbers with us, the Bob Crosby Band, when I was with the Bob Crosby Band on the same show, and actually, it was the Lawson-Haggard Jazz Band -- Crosby just fronted it. Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton did bits on that show with us.
It was exciting for me because I finally got to play behind Louis. When we did that Storyville show, the closing of Storyville, for CBS, which I told about in
great detail -- after rehearsal, Louis asked Bobby Hackett and Lou Stein and myself, we all lived on Long Island, he asked us to his house to relax in Corona.
